cohort: 612 patients with singleton pregnancies between 11+0 and 13+6 weeks of gestation and first-trimester serum levels of PAPP-A and/or free b-hCG >= 2.0 MoM.
finding: No higher prevalence of pregnancy complications was detected in women with normal ultrasound findings and high (even extremely high) PAPP-A and/or free b-hCG concentrations.
